summary.name: MemFree
summary.one_liner: MemFree is a hybrid AI search tool that answers questions using both a user's knowledge base and the internet.
use_cases: Get answers combining personal documents and live web results
Summarize and ask questions about a web page or PDF
Search and ask questions about Twitter content
Search and ask questions about Product Hunt listings
summary.what_it_does: MemFree is a hybrid AI search product that draws on a knowledge base and the internet to produce answers. The page lists features for summarizing and asking questions about web pages and PDFs. It also offers searching and asking questions about Twitter and Product Hunt. Users can attach files, choose Web or Image search, and pick a model such as GPT-5 or Mimi. The page does not describe implementation details or pricing.
notable: Hybrid search combining a personal knowledge base with live internet results
Summarize and ask questions about web pages and PDFs
Dedicated Twitter and Product Hunt question search
caveats: Page only shows a 'Try Free Now' call to action; full pricing terms are not stated
Platform support beyond the web app is not mentioned on the page
